title.zh: 【Hyperliquid 明日将收到首笔 AQAv2 储备收益分配，约 1450 万美元用于回购 HYPE】
title.en: 【Hyperliquid 明日将收到首笔 AQAv2 储备收益分配，约 1450 万美元用于回购 HYPE】

current_state.zh: Hyperliquid is expected to receive its first AQAv2 reserve revenue distribution — roughly $14.5 million in USDC yield — on October 3, with the funds flowing into the Assistance Fund to buy back HYPE.
